title: Bus Stop: 2048!
description: Game Features: 1. Unique gameplay allows passengers to board their cars and leave the station. 2. Collect cool cars, unlock and collect cool cars in each level of play. 3. There are many types of cars in the game store, waiting for players to purchase them.
instructions: 1 The goal of the game is to distribute passengers to their cars and know how to free all passengers 2 Use tools during the mission to complete the level faster 3 Just click on the car of the same color as the passenger to match them
